astertune.description:
AsterTune is a free, open-source music player for Android that combines local music playback with access to YouTube Music in a modern Material Design 3 interface. Based on OuterTune, it offers a flexible listening experience with customizable appearance and playback controls.

Stream music from YouTube Music, play songs in the background, download tracks for offline listening, and synchronize your library with your YouTube Music account. Browse and play locally stored audio files, organize playlists, and combine local and online songs in the same playback queue.

AsterTune supports synchronized lyrics, including word-level lyrics, with sources such as LRCLIB, KuGou, SimpMusic, BetterLyrics, and YouTube captions. Additional features include Android Auto support, audio normalization, a sleep timer, customizable accent colors, playlist management, and tablet-friendly layouts.

The app is available in Core and Full editions, with the Full edition providing additional FFmpeg-powered audio decoders. No subscription is required for the app itself. An internet connection is needed for online music features, and AsterTune is not affiliated with Google or YouTube.
